newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom sees 10 bln ffr 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom sees 10 bln ffr 1996 profit.

text.p: French Telecom has increased its forecast for its 1996 profit to 10 billion francs, from 8.7 billion previously, after its board studied the first half results, the Le Monde newspaper said.
France Telecom could not immediately comment.

The newspaper said the operator, due to be partially privatised in the spring of 1997, expected 1996 sales of 134.65 billion and an operating profit of 24.5 billion, slightly lower than the 25.1 billion originally budgetted. But lower financial charges lift the net figure.

The figures do not take account of special payments, such as a provision to make up the one-off pension payment, of 37.5 billion francs, to the state. There are already 22 billion francs provided for this payment.

In the first half, sales of the parent group France Telecom were up 1.3 percent to 67.4 billion, operating profit was up 3.9 percent 14.9 billion and the net profit rose 16.3 percent to 5.9 billion, Le Monde said.
